howto.name: Upload a GIF
howto.text: Drop a GIF — single-frame GIFs convert cleanly with transparency preserved.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The first frame becomes a lossless PNG, perfect for icons and animated avatars converted to stills.

faq.a: Only the first frame is converted to PNG. For animated GIFs, consider converting to a video format like MP4 or WebM using our GIF to MP4 tool.
Yes — PNG fully supports transparency, so transparent areas of the GIF come through cleanly.
Yes. Both GIF and PNG are lossless formats, so the first frame is reproduced pixel-perfectly.
